description: This file implements timeout management functions for network operations, including setting timeouts, calculating deadlines, remaining time, and evaluating timeout status.

methods.name: net_timeout_set
methods.description: Initializes a net_timeout structure with a specified lifetime and current time.

methods.name: net_timeout_deadline
methods.description: Calculates the deadline timestamp for a given timeout based on current time.

methods.name: net_timeout_remaining
methods.description: Returns the remaining time in milliseconds before the timeout expires.

methods.name: net_timeout_evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the current status of the timeout, updating internal state and returning time remaining.
